name: Eye-Level View
name_es: Vista a la altura de los ojos

camera_angle.orientation_reference: Subject left and right mean the anatomical sides of the subject, never the viewer screen sides.
camera_angle.description: camera at the subject eye level, horizontal sightline
camera_angle.application: When scope is general, change only overall camera height/tilt; when scope is subject_relative, select an orientation from orientation_options. Do not rotate the subject to simulate a camera move.
